## News

- Minecraft 1.20.1 ~ 1.20.6 support
- Minecraft 1.19.4 support
- Minecraft 20w20a support

## Changes

- Merged all mc-version-separated branches into a single branch via [preprocessor](https://github.com/ReplayMod/preprocessor)
- Made rule `endLightningRod` only affect Minecraft < 1.17
- Made rule `editableSign` only affect Minecraft < 1.20

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Ivan-1F/Ivan-Carpet-Addition/compare/v2.2.2...v3.0.0

releases.notes:
## Rules

- Added `spongeDryInNether`: Wet sponge will dry in nether
- Added `magmaBlockDamageItem`: Items on magma block get damage
- Added `functionalSpongeItem`: Sponge item do water clearance and dry in the nether
- Added `fakePlayerPrefixCheck`: Check the prefix of fake players when using player command
- Added `fakePlayerSuffixCheck`: Check the suffix of fake players when using player command
- Added `mobSpawningRestrictionMode`: Modify the way to restrict mob spawning (black list or white list)
- Added `mobBlackList`: Avoid some mobs from spawning
- Added `mobWhiteList`: Only allow some mobs to spawn
- Removed `bannedMobs`

## Fixes

 - Fixed #2: Mob spawning restriction doesn't work when using a language other than English
 - Fixed: Rule `magmaBlockDestroyItem` doesn't affect by the toggle in 1.14.4

## Patches

### v1.4.1

- Stops log spam of  `[main/WARN]: WARNING! Mod ivan-carpet-addition is only using deprecated 'modmenu:parent' custom value! This will be removed in 1.18 snapshots, so ask the author of this mod to support the new API.` by upgrading the `modmenu` api
- Add a welcome message to the server console when u load this mod
- Fixed the judgement of mob type when dealing with mob spawning restriction

### v1.4.2

 - Keep everything up to date

### v1.4.3

 - Some refactoring on versioning and github CI

## Requirements

| Minecraft      | Ivan Carpet Addition | fabric carpet          |
| -------------- | -------------------- | ---------------------- |
| 1.14.4         | mc1.14.4-1.4.x       | >=1.3.7                |
| 1.15.2         | mc1.15.2-1.4.x       | >=1.4.8                |
| 1.16.4, 1.16.5 | mc1.16.4-1.4.x       | >=1.4.25               |
| 1.17 snapshots | mc21w-1.4.x          | as new as possible ofc |
